meta.title: FAQ - Touresim
meta.description: Answers to frequently asked travel questions

visa-requirements.q: How do I check visa requirements for my passport?
visa-requirements.a: Use our visa checker tool to select your passport nationality and destination. We'll show you the requirements and processing times.

passport-validity.q: How long should my passport be valid?
passport-validity.a: Most countries require your passport to be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. Some countries require more.

travel-budget.q: How much budget should I plan for?
travel-budget.a: Budget varies by destination. We provide cost-of-living guides for each country to help you plan.

best-time-to-visit.q: What's the best time to visit a destination?
best-time-to-visit.a: Each country has different peak and shoulder seasons. Check our destination pages for weather patterns and festival calendars.

travel-insurance.a: Travel insurance is highly recommended to cover medical emergencies, trip cancellations, and lost luggage.

vaccinations.a: Vaccination requirements vary by destination. Consult your doctor or CDC/WHO website for current requirements.

currency-exchange.a: Exchange at your bank before traveling or use ATMs abroad. Avoid airport exchanges which often have poor rates.

travel-apps.q: What apps do I need for travel?
travel-apps.a: Essential apps include maps (Google Maps, offline), translation (Google Translate), and money management (Wise, OANDA).

luggage-restrictions.q: What are luggage restrictions on flights?
luggage-restrictions.a: Most airlines allow 1-2 carry-ons and 1-2 checked bags. Check your airline's specific policy.

travel-documentation.q: What documents do I need to travel?
travel-documentation.a: Minimum: passport, visa (if required), travel insurance, and flight confirmations. Make copies and store digitally.

hotel-booking.a: Book 2-3 months in advance for best rates. Consider booking directly with hotels for better cancellation policies.

travel-insurance-claims.q: How do I file a travel insurance claim?
travel-insurance-claims.a: Keep all receipts and documents. Contact your insurer promptly with evidence of the incident.
